targetText: [14] The reference is to the otzovists [the term otzovist derives from the Russian verb “otozvat” meaning “to recall”.
summary: The Otzovists (Recallists) were an ultra-left Bolshevik faction who rejected all legal and parliamentary forms of struggle.
explanation: The Otzovists (Recallists) were an ultra-left Bolshevik faction who advocated recalling socialist deputies from the tsarist Duma, rejecting all legal forms of political activity.

targetText: It is in this way that the “leaders” of the British trade unions, as well as of the Fabian society and the “Independent” Labour Party, dodge responsibility for the treachery they have perpetrated, for having made a compromise that is really tantamount to the worst kind of opportunism, treachery and betrayal.
explanation: Lenin supported tactical electoral support for the British Labour Party to help workers experience Labour leaders in power and realize their reformist limitations.
